28522: Shichika is the current head of the Kyotouryuu style. He was trained rigorously by his father, the previous head of the style. He is deeply dedicated to his training, and is strong enough to win against challengers without even using Kyotouryuu.
28523: Togame is the shogunate's self-titled "strategian." She is physically weak but mentally superior, though she is not immune to lapses in judgment and bouts of clumsiness.
28556: Nanami Yasuri is Shichika's elder sister. She's a sickly girl who's babied by him. She's extremely intelligent and knows many things despite living on a secluded island her entire life.
28557: Shichika and Nanami's father, previous master of Kyotouryuu, who died a year prior to the story's events.
28558: The first Maniwani member Shichika meets. His name literally means "bat," and he models his clothing after one accordingly. He is the holder of the deviant sword Kanna and has the ability to swallow it completely to protect it.
30089: Uneri is the holder of the deviant blade Namakura. Togame offers him anything in exchange for Namakura, but his wish of restoring Inaba can't be fulfilled, so he opts to fight Shichika instead. His style, Zerosen, entails cutting with the sword faster than the speed of light.
30250: Shirasagi is one of the twelve ninja leaders of the Maniwani. His name literally means "heron," and he dresses like one accordingly. He has an interesting quirk: he speaks backwards.
30309: The strongest swordsman in Japan. He is the owner of the deviant blade Hari. His catchphrase, as stated many times by Togame, is: "I will have you fall for me."
30956: Meisai is the holder of the deviant sword Tsurugi, which is split into 1000 swords. "Tsuruga Meisai" is the name of the previous priest of the shrine she presides over; she claims that she forgot her original name.
32212: The leader of the Insect Group of the Maniwani. His name literally means "praying mantis," and he models his clothing after one accordingly. He is sent to kidnap Nanami.
32268: The youngest member of the Insect Group of the Maniwani. His name means "honey bee," and he models his clothing after one accordingly. He is sent to kidnap Nanami.
32269: A member of the Insect Group of the Maniwani. His name means "butterfly," and he dresses like one accordingly. He recently quit smoking because the Maniwani member he is in love with, Maniwa Oshidori, hates it.
32270: Kuizame is one of the twelve head Maniwani ninjas. He is introduced in episode 3. His name includes the word for "shark," and he dresses like one accordingly. He claims that his only motivation for killing is money.
33206: A self-proclaimed "Man of Kyushu", the captain of the Yoroi Pirates ruling over the port in Satsuma, as well as the wielder of the fifth Perfected Deviant Blade, Zokutou Yoroi - an impenetrable suit of armor.
33207: Introduced in episode 5. Houou's name refers to the mythical firebird, and he dresses accordingly. According to Togame, he is on a different level than the other 11 Maniwani heads and is not to be trifled with.
33208: A mysterious and seemingly cruel girl who appears to know more than she lets on, Princess Hitei is Togame's archrival and constantly schemes to interfere with Togame's mission.
34045: Konayuki is the last remaining member of the Itezora clan. She is immensely strong, but claims to be the weakest of her peers, and much weaker than the adults in her clan.
34924: A faithful follower of Princess Hitei, he's been informing her about Togame's adventures for some time. A rather quiet person, he sits in on Princess Hitei's boastful conversations. He shows little emotion and does not get along well with Togame.
34925: The leader of the Fish Squad. As his name suggests, he wears a turtle-like uniform. He wields a rapier. Source: Wikipedia
34926: The leader of the Beast Squad, he is invaluable to the Maniwa Corps as he can ascertain the locations of the Deviant Blades. As his name suggests, he wears an otter-like uniform.
34927: One of the twelve leaders of the Maniwa Ninja. Her ability is transferring her soul into another (Human) body, possessing it.
34928: A member of the Bird Squad, she is first mentioned as the object of Chouchou's affection. As her name suggests, she wears a duck-like uniform. She fights Emonzaemon while letting her leader and Penguin flee.
34929: A member of the Fish Squad, he is the group's informant and its youngest head. As his name suggests, he wears a penguin-like uniform. A shy and soft-spoken boy, he stutters when trying to bring something up. Source: Wikipedia
